messages:
jess: Heads-up — Tenant Zeta reporting intermittent 503s from our Hosted/Dedicated edge when hitting /v1/generate. Started ~2026-03-16T22:10Z. Example request IDs: req_8a7f1b2d and req_9c3e4f5a. App team sees 'upstream read timeout' in API gateway and GPU OOM lines in node dmesg. Can we collect a repro bundle + curl that reproduces?

sam: Can you paste a minimal curl that reproduces? Also which cluster/node/pod names so ops can grab logs quickly.

jess: Curl they used (redacted key):
```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -H "X-Request-ID: req_8a7f1b2d" 
  --data '{"model":"redwood-large-quant","input":"Summarize ledger events for acct 0xabc...","max_tokens":256}' 
```
Response: repeated 503s and sometimes truncated streams.

jess: Affected infra: dedicated cluster id zeta-dedicated-1. Pod names from `kubectl get pods -n tenant-zeta` earlier: `zeta-api-5f7d6` and `zeta-worker-0`. Node: gpunode-11.eu-west-2.

mike: OK — ops checklist: please run these (we can open a support bundle script if you prefer):
1) pod logs (container + all restarts): `kubectl logs -n tenant-zeta zeta-api-5f7d6 --all-containers --timestamps > /tmp/zeta-api.logs`
2) describe + events: `kubectl describe pod -n tenant-zeta zeta-api-5f7d6 > /tmp/zeta-api.describe`
3) on node gpunode-11: `sudo dmesg | grep -i oom -A5 > /tmp/dmesg-oom.txt` and `sudo journalctl -u docker -o short-iso --since "2026-03-16 22:00" > /tmp/docker-journal.log`
4) GPU snapshot: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,memory.total,memory.used,utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu --format=csv -lms 1000 -c 1 > /tmp/gpu-snapshot.csv` (attach one at time of repro)
5) profiler: if safe, `sudo /opt/redwood/bin/sysprof-capture --duration 30 --output /tmp/sysprof-30s.tgz`

anna: I'll add grep hints to correlate request IDs to container logs: `grep -R "req_8a7f1b2d\|req_9c3e4f5a" /var/log/pods /var/log/containers || kubectl logs -n tenant-zeta zeta-api-5f7d6 | grep req_8a7f1b2d`  — note logs may be sharded across sidecars. Also check kv-cache metrics on the worker: `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9119/metrics | grep kvcache` on the worker pod.

jess: I can collect these. Two small asks from ops: 1) exact time window to collect (we'll do 22:05-22:30Z) and 2) a place to upload.

mike: Use the support-bucket presigned path: `s3://redwood-support/ingest/tenant-zeta/2026-03-16/2867-repro-uploads/` — run the helper to tar and upload: `sudo /usr/local/bin/support-collect.sh --request-ids req_8a7f1b2d,req_9c3e4f5a --since "2026-03-16T22:05:00Z" --until "2026-03-16T22:30:00Z" --include-gpu-metrics --out /tmp/zeta-repro.tgz && aws s3 cp /tmp/zeta-repro.tgz s3://redwood-support/ingest/tenant-zeta/2026-03-16/2867-repro-uploads/zeta-repro.tgz --acl bucket-owner-full-control`

jess: Running support-collect now. Posting quick grep snippets in case you want to triage before full bundle uploads:
```
# from /var/log/kern.log on gpunode-11
[Mar 16 22:12:05] Out of memory: Killed process 31245 (python) total-vm:... size=...
[Mar 16 22:12:07] NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus
```

jess: pod logs (tail) show repeated 502->503 transition around 22:12:
```
2026-03-16T22:11:58Z zeta-api - WARN pipeline - upstream read timeout after 12s, req=req_8a7f1b2d
2026-03-16T22:12:04Z zeta-api - ERROR model-run - process killed by OOM while writing kvcache, trace=req_8a7f1b2d
```

sam: Good catch. Two parallel asks: (A) try a single-threaded curl loop to reproduce and attach `-H "X-Request-ID: <id>"` per request; (B) ops: snapshot GPU utilization and nvlink errors right after I trigger a limited repro. Example repro wrapper: 
```bash
for i in {1..8}; do 
  RID=$(printf "req_repro_%02d" "$i")
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "X-Request-ID: $RID" -d '{"model":"redwood-large-quant","input":"spam","max_tokens":16}' &
  sleep 0.5
done
```

mike: I'll take the node snapshot now and collect `dmesg`, `nvidia-smi -q`, and journalctl windows. If the support-collect runs OK, post S3 path here.

jess: Upload complete: `s3://redwood-support/ingest/tenant-zeta/2026-03-16/2867-repro-uploads/zeta-repro.tgz` (presigned link sent to zeta-platform).

zeta-platform: Thanks — we downloaded and we can reproduce locally when we replay the same request IDs. We saw the worker's kv-cache spike to >95% memory then OOM. We'll follow up with a reproduction run on a staging slice and share flamegraphs.

anna: After we confirm repro on staging, recommend a temporary fallback policy: route tenant-zeta requests to redwood-medium-quant for 1 hour and throttle concurrency to reduce pressure until we push a patch.

sam: +1. tagging eng-runtime to prioritize a fix. :thumbsup:

mike: Closing loop — bundle and node snapshot are attached to the ticket. If zeta needs faster rollback to hosted fallback, say so and we'll flip routing.

jess: Thanks team — keeping ticket updated. Will paste flamegraphs when staging run finishes.
